Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE independently edited native transparent PNG sprite, preferred native 1254 by 1254 (never below 1024), the exact same full-canvas placement and normalized scale as input 1. Input 1 is the edit target: Moon Shadow Assassin Girl attack facing EAST frame 02. Input 2 is the approved project painting STYLE reference only, not content or layout. Keep the detailed clean rounded hand-painted chibi style, silver bob and ahoge, purple eye, navy and ivory costume, gold trim, turquoise beads and both curved daggers exactly like input 1.
ONLY EDIT THE SCREEN-LEFT REAR BOOT BELOW THE ANKLE. The current screen-left rear boot wrongly points to the left/down-left away from the EAST attack axis. Turn this one boot on its ankle so the heel-to-toe direction is SCREEN RIGHT or gently SCREEN RIGHT-DOWN: heel on the boot's screen-left side, toe cap projecting to the screen-right side. Show the appropriate side/top perspective of that right-pointing rear boot. Keep navy material, gold rim, ankle straps, buckle, small gold star and crescent decoration consistent. This is a local foot rotation, NOT a change to the leg pose.
Preserve the ankle position, rear foot planted ground/contact height, rear foot overall contact location, wide lunge leg spacing, bent front knee, whole rear leg above ankle, the untouched SCREEN-RIGHT FRONT boot, body lean, exact arm/hand/dagger pose, face, hair, scarf, clothing, decorations, lighting, camera, and all full-canvas geometry. Do not stand the character up, narrow the stance, move or reshape the head, alter hands or weapons, swap left/right limbs, duplicate from another animation frame, mirror the image, crop, recenter or ground-align the whole figure. Precisely two arms, two hands, two legs, two boots, two daggers. Actual alpha transparency, no floor, shadow, background, checkerboard, text, effects or border. Output only the full isolated sprite with this single rear-boot orientation correction.
